pages:
The west lawns are the best lawns.
I've checked all of them.
My flat is on the fifth floor.

The lift is out again.
This walk is my rest stop.

The canal boats used to carry grain.
Now they carry tourists.
The ring road goes all the way round.

I've walked it twice today.
I'm not lost. I'm exercising.

Market lawn's the best spot for lunch.
Mind the pigeons. They're bold.
Head office is up in that tower.

They say you can see Saltmere
from the top floor. On payday.
